# Storage API

## Overview

The Storage API is the main API for Keboola Connection. It provides access to all data stored in Keboola.

## Authentication

All requests require authentication using a Storage API token:

```
X-StorageApi-Token: your-token-here
```

## Base URL

```
https://connection.keboola.com/v2/storage
```

## Endpoints

### Buckets

- `GET /buckets` - List all buckets
- `GET /buckets/{bucketId}` - Get bucket details
- `POST /buckets` - Create a new bucket
- `DELETE /buckets/{bucketId}` - Delete a bucket

### Tables

- `GET /tables/{tableId}` - Get table details
- `POST /tables/{tableId}/export-async` - Export table data
- `POST /tables/{tableId}/import-async` - Import data to table
- `DELETE /tables/{tableId}` - Delete a table

## Incremental Loading

Incremental loading allows you to load only new or changed data:

```json
{
  "incremental": true,
  "incrementalFetchingColumn": "updated_at"
}
```
